lines.text: A brief detour. Aarav's neighbour Ravi once dreamed of becoming a cricketer. When that door closed, Ravi started drinking. Now Ravi's only daily priority is the next drink.
He used to be the best batsman on the street.
Addiction: a preference that has escaped rational control. Ravi has not chosen, reflected, or adapted. His desires have been captured.
Elster places addiction on the same map as the other mechanisms — it too produces preference change. But here the person has lost autonomy rather than exercised it.
